📖 How to use

  1. Enter your annual freelance income and deductible business expenses.
  2. Enter your effective tax rate as a percentage.
  3. Read taxable income, estimated tax and quarterly payments.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the estimate calculated?

Taxable income = gross annual income − business expenses. Estimated tax = taxable income × the tax rate you enter.

What is a quarterly payment?

Self-employed workers typically pay in four quarterly installments: estimated annual tax ÷ 4.

Why is this only an estimate?

This is a flat-rate educational estimate. Real tax depends on brackets, deductions, self-employment tax and your jurisdiction — use your actual marginal rate or ask a professional.
